prompt:
Locked-off static shot, eye level, straight-on view of a plain hallway wall. On the left side of the wall: a round, unbranded wall thermostat with a brushed metal bezel and a black display showing one large white number. Immediately to the right of the thermostat, on the same wall: a window. Through the window: a gentle hill, a single tree, and the sea in the distance. No logos, no text other than the thermostat number. 16:9.

Night. The thermostat display shows "23". Through the window: a bare leafless tree on a hill with no snow, winter, the sea far away. Dim hallway, cold blue night light coming through the window.

cinematic, photorealistic, warm colors, soft light
